name: Wellspring River
summary: In Teldrassil, Wellspring River carries fresh water north from Wellspring Lake before plunging to the ocean below. Its banks have grown dangerous as the timberlings turn hostile.

sections.title: Waters of the World Tree
sections.body: Wellspring River runs north from Wellspring Lake through Teldrassil's forest before falling from the great tree into the sea below. Its banks are no longer safe. The timberlings living there have grown crazed and attack travelers and druids who come near the water.

faq.q: Where does the Wellspring River lead?
faq.answer: Wellspring River flows north from Wellspring Lake, then reaches the edge of Teldrassil's canopy and plunges in a great waterfall to the ocean below.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings along the river attacking people?
faq.answer: The timberlings along Wellspring River have grown erratic and crazed, attacking anyone nearby. This unrest among Teldrassil's wildlife alarms the local night elven druids.

faq.q: Where does the water in the river come from?
aliases: where does wellspring water come from
faq.answer: Wellspring River flows from Wellspring Lake, which is fed by a natural freshwater spring deep within the living trunk and boughs of the World Tree.

angles.text: The maddened timberlings along Wellspring River are an unsettling sign of sickness spreading through Teldrassil's ecosystem.
The freshwater waterways flowing from Teldrassil's heart represent the vitality of the Kaldorei's new home, so unrest along their banks is deeply concerning.
